Title: Azure HDInsight—Interactive querying and Log Analytics

Body.Content: HDInsight now has two additional features available—HDI Interactive Query, and Azure Log Analytics. HDI Interactive Query (formerly Interactive Hive) will allow in-memory caching that will make queries more interactive and performant. Azure Log Analytics integration is now also available for public preview. This will allow you to proactively monitor and analyze logs and metrics data, and will empower you to optimize availability and performance across your resources. Learn more about these features by visiting our documentation webpage.
